question: Find all male patients who were admitted to the hospital, had laboratory tests between 1980 and 1990, and show normal levels of both white blood cells (WBC) and hemoglobin (HGB). For each such patient, return their ID, sex, admission status, age at the time of the test, and the date of the laboratory test. Additionally, include only those patients whose total protein (TP) is also within the normal range (6.0 < TP < 8.5), and exclude any records where platelet count (PLT) is outside the normal range (100–400). Order the results by age at test in descending order, and for patients of the same age, sort by laboratory test date in ascending order.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    T1."XCL_058",
    T1."XCL_059",
    T3."XCL_013",
    T2."XCL_016",
    T2."XCL_015"
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1."XCL_058" = T3."XCL_001"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T3."XCL_013" > 0
  AND T2."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
  AND T2."XCL_030" BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
  AND T2."XCL_032" BETWEEN 10.0 AND 17.0
  AND T2."XCL_020" > 6.0
  AND T2."XCL_020" < 8.5
  AND T2."XCL_027" BETWEEN 100 AND 400
ORDER BY T2."XCL_016" DESC, T2."XCL_015" ASC

react.initial_search_query: Find all male patients who were admitted to the hospital, had laboratory tests between 1980 and 1990, and show normal levels of both white blood cells (WBC) and hemoglobin (HGB). For each such patient, return their ID, sex, admission status, age at the time of the test, and the date of the laboratory test. Additionally, include only those patients whose total protein (TP) is also within the normal range (6.0 < TP < 8.5), and exclude any records where platelet count (PLT) is outside the normal range (100–400). Order the results by age at test in descending order, and for patients of the same age, sort by laboratory test date in ascending order.

FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1."XCL_058" = T2."XCL_014"
WHERE T1."XCL_059" = 'M'
  AND T1."XCL_061" IS NOT NULL
  AND T2."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
  AND T2."XCL_016" BETWEEN 4 AND 11
  AND T2."XCL_019" BETWEEN 13 AND 17
  AND T2."XCL_020" > 6.0 AND T2."XCL_020" < 8.5
  AND T2."XCL_018" BETWEEN 100 AND 400
ORDER BY T2."XCL_017" DESC, T2."XCL_015" ASC

SELECT 
    p.XCL_058 AS patient_id,
    p.XCL_063 AS sex,
    e.XCL_006 AS admission_status,
    (julianday(l.XCL_015) - julianday(p.XCL_060)) / 365.25 AS age_at_test,
    l.XCL_015 AS lab_test_date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.XCL_058 = l.XCL_014
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
WHERE 
    p.XCL_063 = 'M'
    AND e.XCL_006 = 'Admitted'
    AND l.XCL_015 BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1990-12-31'
    AND l.XCL_020 BETWEEN 4.0 AND 11.0  -- WBC normal range
    AND l.XCL_021 BETWEEN 12.0 AND 16.0 -- HGB normal range
    AND l.XCL_022 BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5   -- TP normal range
    AND l.XCL_023 BETWEEN 100 AND 400   -- PLT normal range
ORDER BY 
    age_at_test DESC,
    l.XCL_015 ASC
